title: Nice ladle
text: Nice ladle. Very nice rounded soup ladle. The only thing that I am used to having is a pour spout and this doesnt have one. It doesnt affect the pouring though because it doesnt drip. Very thick sturdy material and handle. Will last a long time...but I agree that the handle is too curved, and can make it feel awkward to pour.
